endings.title: Endings
endings.mortality.name: Mortality
endings.myth.name: The Myth
endings.ascension.name: Ascension
endings.mortality.offer: {court.name} offers to make you mortal: a voice of its court can end the dragon in you.
endings.ascension.offer: The prophecy has come true. The peoples are ready to raise you up.
endings.mortality.epilogue: You left the mountain and lived one mortal life in {court.name}.
endings.myth.epilogue: Your death passed into legend. The next valley will remember you.
endings.ascension.epilogue: You rose above the valley, and its peoples kept your temples for an age.
endings.mortality.voice.met: {court.name} has a voice that could unmake you, and its awe of you is deep enough.
endings.mortality.voice.missing: No court that holds you in awe has a sage or priest who could unmake you.
endings.mortality.audience.missing: You have not received that court at your ledge in your last two wakings.
endings.myth.reign.met: Your reign is long enough to be told.
endings.myth.reign.missing: Your reign is too short for a legend.
endings.myth.monumental.met: Two courts keep you in stone.
endings.myth.monumental.missing: Fewer than two courts keep you in stone.
endings.myth.legends.met: Your deeds are kept in books and stone.
endings.myth.legends.missing: Too few of your deeds are kept in books or stone.
endings.ascension.peoples.met: Four courts of three peoples love and worship you.
endings.ascension.peoples.missing: Fewer than four courts of three peoples love and worship you.
endings.ascension.temples.met: Your temples stand in the courts that love you, and three are old.
endings.ascension.temples.missing: Not every court that loves you has an old temple of yours.
endings.ascension.craft.met: The air is thick with old craft.
endings.ascension.craft.missing: The valley's magic is still too thin.
endings.ascension.voice.met: A priest of yours speaks for three peoples, and the office has outlived one of them.
endings.ascension.voice.missing: No priest of yours speaks for three peoples yet.
endings.ascension.mild.met: The courts that love you do not fear you much.
endings.ascension.mild.missing: The courts that love you fear you too much.
endings.ascension.strong.met: The peoples are strong enough to raise you, and strong enough to kill you.
endings.ascension.strong.missing: The peoples are not yet strong enough to raise you.
endings.ascension.dominion.met: Your dominion and your gifts are enough.
endings.ascension.dominion.missing: Your dominion or your gifts to the faithful are not enough.
prophecy.title: The prophecy
prophecy.loved_by_peoples.2: When the fire is loved by {n} houses of {races} kinds,
prophecy.house_of_stone.1: and a house of stone stands in each, {years} years old,
prophecy.house_of_stone.2: and every house that loves it has built it a hall of stone,
prophecy.old_craft.1: and the air is thick with old craft,
prophecy.old_craft.2: and the old arts wake again,
prophecy.one_voice.1: and one voice speaks for {races} peoples,
prophecy.one_voice.2: and one living voice sings it for many kinds,
prophecy.ending_noun: then the dragon shall rise and be a god.
myth.qualifies: Your death passes into legend. The next valley will remember you.
myth.not_yet: Your death is not yet a legend: {missing}
legend.text: {name}, who reigned {reign} years and fell to {killer}.
